title: Gender Bias in Perception of Human Managers Extends to AI Managers

bias_targets.methodology: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) assigning participants to work under managers presented as male, female, or gender-unspecified (both human and AI), followed by surveys and linear regression modeling to measure perceptions of the manager's trustworthiness, competence, fairness, and the participant's willingness to collaborate in the future.

Comparing participant survey evaluations (trust, competence, fairness, and willingness to work together) for randomly assigned AI managers versus human managers after an award decision in a team-based task.
